panels.description: Current state and selected-range activity. Down rows sort before healthy rows; select an interface to focus diagnostics.

targets.expr:
max by (job, switch, interface) (
  label_replace(
    arista_phy_pcs_high_ber{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch",interface=~"$interface"},
    "signal", "high_ber", "interface", ".*"
  )
  or
  label_replace(
    arista_phy_mac_local_fault{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch",interface=~"$interface"},
    "signal", "local_fault", "interface", ".*"
  )
  or
  label_replace(
    arista_phy_mac_remote_fault{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch",interface=~"$interface"},
    "signal", "remote_fault", "interface", ".*"
  )
)
